content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-198. - I.R.C. Section N1101.1, Scope.
content.summary:
Section N1101. Scope,
is hereby amended to add an exception as follows:
"Exception.
1.
Portions of the building envelope that do not enclose conditioned space."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 6, 9-14-2020)
